nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Block 11 (ADR-036). Resolver inputs: output_blocks_json (drafting-model block list), impact, input_image_refs_json (from Read Input, for embed resolution), clickup_task_id + passthrough. model/cost_pln are the TEXT run attribution (forwarded by the caller to Post Reply; resolver does not use them).

nodes.name: Lookup Image Config
nodes.notes: Reads both image limits in one row: image-count safety ceiling (config.image_count_ceiling=20, migration 026 — runaway guard, NOT a per-impact cap) and the parallel-batch concurrency cap (config.image_concurrency_cap, migration 031 set 4 -> 033 raised to 5; ADR-051). ceiling -> Resolve & Explode Blocks; concurrency_cap -> Build Batch Request (passed into Generate Images Parallel).

parameters.query:
select
  (max(value) filter (where key = 'image_count_ceiling'))::int as ceiling,
  (max(value) filter (where key = 'image_concurrency_cap'))::int as concurrency_cap
from config
where key in ('image_count_ceiling', 'image_concurrency_cap');

nodes.name: Resolve & Explode Blocks
nodes.notes: Parses output_blocks_json + input_image_refs_json; builds embed lookup map; explodes to one item per block with a route (text|embed|generate|drop). Generate blocks past the ceiling get route=drop. Assigns placeholder_id gen_N to each generate. ADR-052 Block 2: generate items also carry reference_refs[] (from the block) + lookup_map (the same source_ref/url-keyed input map embed uses) so Build Batch Request can resolve references to URLs.

nodes.name: Classify Block
nodes.notes: Routes each exploded block by $json.route to one of 4 outputs: 0 text, 1 embed, 2 generate, 3 fallback(=drop). Text passes straight to Merge; the others get per-branch handling.

nodes.name: Resolve Embed
nodes.notes: embed_input: resolve ref/source_ref against the input image lookup map -> {type:attachment} (existing CU attachment, no re-upload). Miss -> embed_failed + warning.

nodes.name: Build Batch Request
nodes.notes: ADR-051 Block 4: collects ALL active generate blocks (Classify generate branch) into ONE batch request for Generate Images Parallel (v1): requests_json = array of {placeholder_id,prompt,size,aspect,caption,alt,block_order,reference_urls[]}; + shared impact + passthrough + concurrency_cap (from Lookup Image Config). runOnceForAllItems, single incoming connection. Replaces the old per-image Call Invoke Model (mode:each, sequential) — the batch fires them concurrently. ADR-052 Block 2: holds the standalone, caller-agnostic resolveReferenceToUrl(ref, lookup) (reused verbatim by the future generate_image tool handler, ADR-053/054); resolves each generate block's reference_refs[] against its lookup_map into reference_urls[], and a miss -> prebatch_warnings[] (placeholder_id + multimodal/reference-ref-not-found). prebatch_warnings rides this node's OUTPUT (not requests_json) because executeWorkflow replaces the item; Handle Gen Result reads it back by node reference. reference_urls[] is the migration seam consumed by Block 3-4.

nodes.name: Call Generate Batch
nodes.notes: ADR-051 Block 4: calls Generate Images Parallel (v1) ONCE (id 2keb6XVWq5PG0leK) with the aggregated batch request; returns one item per image {placeholder_id,success,b64_json,model,cost_pln,size,degraded,resolution_note,caption,alt,warnings[]}. Default mode (run once) — Build Batch Request emits exactly one item. onError=continueRegularOutput: a batch THROW (only the Vault-key-missing path, already CRITICALed by the batch's own errorWorkflow) passes the request item through; Handle Gen Result detects that shape and degrades to per-placeholder failures so the comment still posts (image non-blocking, ADR-047).

nodes.name: Handle Gen Result
nodes.notes: ADR-051 Block 4: maps Generate Images Parallel results back to blocks, joined by placeholder_id carried through the batch (no more task_type meta smuggling). runOnceForAllItems. success -> generate_success (manifest + image_model + cost_pln + resolution_note); failure/no-b64 -> generate_failed. Carries each image's warnings[] (degrade / cost-header-missing / gen-failed) forward for Assemble Output to fold into the resolver warnings[] -> execute-llm-call's Has Warnings? fires the WARN. If the batch THREW (Call Generate Batch passed its request item through), degrades to one generate_failed per placeholder so the comment still posts. ADR-052 Block 2: folds Build Batch Request's prebatch_warnings[] (reference-ref-not-found, read back by node reference since executeWorkflow drops the field) into each placeholder's warnings[] by placeholder_id.

nodes.name: Build Dropped Block
nodes.notes: Generate block past the global safety ceiling: emits a placeholder text op + multimodal/image-count-ceiling warning (abnormal; should not fire in normal use).

nodes.name: Merge Branches
nodes.notes: Append all four branches (text / resolved-embed / gen-result / dropped) into one stream. Safe with empty branches (Block 3). Single output to Assemble Output (the sole terminal).

nodes.name: Assemble Output
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL (sub-workflow return determinism): exactly one incoming connection. Sorts by block_order, renders text via the same markdown->{text,...} ops as Build Comment, interleaves embed/generated image ops, and returns {image_manifest, rendered_delta, total_image_cost_pln, image_models, warnings} for Stage C (Post Reply).
